title: KickFlip “hate blueberry” M/V 🫐 | Film by Donghwa
description:
💔🫐
이번 5집 음악방송 활동을 마무리하며 위플립 분들께 작은 선물을 남깁니다!
숙소, 연습실, 그리고 스케줄 중 여러 공간에서의 멤버들을 담아보았습니다..!
그냥 한번 찍어보고 싶어서 시작한 건데, 촬영하면서 멤버들과 추억이 생겨 더 재미있었고 위플립에게 이렇게 서프라이즈로 보여줄 수 있어서 더 행복하네요!
이쁘게 봐주세요!
- 동화 -

Since our 5th mini album promotions have come to an end, I wanted to leave a little gift for WeFlip!
I've always wanted to try making a video like this, so I captured some behind-the-scenes moments and little clips of us in our practice room, dorm, and other places.
A lot happened while I was filming and putting everything together, which made the whole process even more fun! And I'm even happier that I get to share it with you as a surprise!
Hope you enjoy watching! - Donghwa -
